decisions.reason: The accepted fixture positions apply specifically to the Unit 1 en-suite bathroom and do not change Unit 3 bathroom geometry or its left-wall shower location.
The Unit 1 toilet and washing-machine placement decision does not alter the independently specified Unit 3 toilet drain location or connection target.
The red-marked toilet position is a Unit 1 bathroom fixture location; it does not entail any change to the partition-wall demolition, construction, or wall-shift rules.
Unit 1 bathroom fixture placement does not change the open-plan kitchen cabinetry configuration or appliance-placement requirements.
The accepted toilet and washing-machine positions within the Unit 1 en-suite do not resolve or modify the common-corridor layout or entrance-hall alternatives.
